newsitem.title: HONG KONG: First Tractor covers over-allocations.
newsitem.headline: First Tractor covers over-allocations.

text.p: First Tractor Co Ltd said on Friday it would issue an additional 18 million new H-shares at HK$4.50 per share to cover over-allocations from its placing.
The company said global coordinator Peregrine Capital Ltd had partially exercised an over-allocation option to require the company to issue the additional shares.

The public shareholding in First Tractor will be increased to 318 million H-shares on completion of the deal from 300 million shares, or to 41.4 percent of the company's enlarged share capital from 40 percent.
First Tractor offered 300 million H-shares at HK$4.50 each in a global flotation earlier this month.
H-shares are shares of Chinese-incorporated companies listed in Hong Kong.
